exposure: Women delivering dichorionic twins with significant (>25%) growth discordance
Women delivering dichorionic twins at a very preterm gestation (or estimated fetal weight <1500 g)
Internal podalic version and breech extraction
Women with a twin pregnancy and a short cervix
cohort: Pregnant women with a dichorionic twin pregnancy.
finding: The guideline provides evidence-based recommendations for the management of dichorionic twin pregnancies, including recommendations for fetal growth monitoring, cervical length assessment, mode of delivery, and timing of delivery.
mod_finding: Planned vaginal delivery carries no increased risk compared with planned cesarean delivery, and internal podalic version and breech extraction is recommended for delivery of the second twin with a non-cephalic presentation.
